prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were mostly too high compared to noise-corrected measurements.
No clear effect was seen for home wait_info changes across 3 tests.
Sign_in hint changes were helpful in one winning test, though no clear effect was seen in two other tests.
Evidence is still thin for adoption redesign and adoption layout changes (only 1 test conducted each).
Evidence is still thin for finish layout and finish new_screen changes (only 1 test conducted each).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, layout: +0.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: -3.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, layout: +2.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: +1.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, wait_info: +0.6% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: +2.3% after noise correction, 3 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.5%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 68.0%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.6%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Grid Layout for Path Selection: Redesign the choose_path screen into a clean grid layout featuring companion visual icons. (why: Path selection has a 76.2% conversion rate and a high mean duration of 514s, indicating decision hesitation.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] Desktop Pet Visibility Preview Screen: Insert a new companion preview screen before finalizing adoption so users can verify rendering options. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation errors and adoption has the lowest step completion rate (60.9%).)
2: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Placement Checklist Setup Flow: Add a pre-launch checklist screen before home_intro to verify desktop pet controls and screen visibility. (why: Support received 3 emails about pets not rendering on desktop and 3 emails asking how to control or hide pets.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Account Sync Reassurance Banner: Add an explicit save file sync hint under the sign in screen headline. (why: 8 support emails (the top support theme) reported lost or reset pets upon signing back into their account.)
4: [finish, copy] Desktop Controls Quick Reference Component: Update the final desktop welcome screen text with right-click interaction instructions. (why: 3 support emails reported post-onboarding confusion on how to hide, control, or interact with their pet.)
5: [choose_path, copy] Path Story Intro Headline Refresh: Simplify story headline and body text to guide users quickly into path selection. (why: The choose_path step has a long mean time of 514s, showing users spend significant time reading intro content.)
6: [home, notification] Desktop Ready Status Notification Indicator: Enable desktop notifications on the waiting screen when asset generation finishes. (why: Home wait median time is 201s (mean 2336s), and users leave the window while assets render.)

scores.note: Addresses long decision time (514s), but complete redesigns carry layout risks.
Targets highest drop step (60.9%) and generation errors, but adding a screen increases friction.
Supported by 6 total emails regarding desktop visibility and controls, but requires building a full flow.
Addresses top support theme (8 emails) with proven sign_in hint pattern (+2.3% historical lift).
Low cost text update addressing post-onboarding confusion backed by 3 support emails.
Simple config copy tweak aiming to reduce reading time at choose_path.
Home wait changes historically yield minimal measured lift (+0.6% across 3 tests).
